sections.t: Energy clearing methods to enhance the Pyrite meaning
sections.html:
Before programming the energy of the Pyrite meaning with your intention for wealth and abundance, make sure to clear and charge its frequencies. When you use effective energy clearing methods before working with the Pyrite crystal meaning, its properties will be open and receptive to working for you as you move forward with your goals. 

Sun and full moon spa

An effective way to recharge the energy of the Pyrite properties is to return it to nature. Harness the powerful and restorative energy of the full sun, the life-giving element straight from mother nature. The powerfully cleansing rays of the sun burn away any old programming or stuck energy, returning the properties of the Pyrite crystal meaning to a brighter and more vibrant form. 

You can also charge and clear your Pyrite with the revitalizing energy of the full moon, which represents the lunar cycle and its steady, healing vibrations. For these cleansing techniques, leave your Pyrite stone outside in a sunny spot or under the light of a full moon for at least 4 hours or more.

Selenite

Sound
